name: auxtools
description: Debug BYOND worlds with breakpoints, stepping, variable inspection, and hot reload.

commands.title: Join with DreamSeeker as a New Guest

auxtools.byondPath.markdownDescription: Path to the BYOND installation directory containing `bin`. Leave empty to detect BYOND automatically.

auxtools.launcherPath.markdownDescription: Path to a custom `auxtools` launcher binary. Leave empty to use the bundled launcher.

auxtools.debugLibrary.markdownDescription: Path to a custom debug library (`debug_server.dll` on Windows or `libdebug_server.so` on Linux). Leave empty to use the bundled library.

auxtools.addToTerminalPath.markdownDescription: Add the launcher directory to `PATH` in VS Code terminals so `auxtools` commands are available there.

auxtools.autoJoin.markdownDescription: Automatically open DreamSeeker when launching a world on Windows. Opened clients reconnect after a reboot.

auxtools.closeDreamSeeker.markdownDescription: Close DreamSeeker clients opened by the extension when their world process exits.

reconnect.description: Offer to reconnect clients after a skin or client script reload.

join.description: Offer to join a world that the extension did not join automatically, or copy its address when DreamSeeker is not available.

rebuild.description: Warn when changes require a reboot or rebuild.

outdated.description: Warn when source or resource files are newer than the .dmb.

dmb.description: Path to the compiled .dmb file to run.

dme.description: Path to the project's .dme file (its directory is the project directory). Defaults to the .dme beside the .dmb.

enumDescriptions: Console DreamDaemon (dd.exe on Windows), with output in the Debug Console
Windowed DreamDaemon (Windows), with output in its own window
Host and join the world in DreamSeeker (Windows)
server.description: Host program that runs the world.

defines.description: Defines used to build the world: NAME, NAME=VALUE, or DreamMaker -D arguments. For matching build tasks, the extension adds the flags selected in SS13 Build Flags. With older versions of SS13 Build Flags, those flags are used only when defines is not set.

hotReload.description: Reload supported source changes on save, including when running without debugging.

sleepingThreads.description: Maximum number of sleeping procs to show in the Call Stack view while paused.

byondPath.description: Path to the BYOND installation directory to use instead of auxtools.byondPath or automatic detection.

port.description: Port the world listens on. Omit to let DreamDaemon choose an available port on startup.

args.description: Arguments passed after the .dmb, replacing the defaults (-trusted, plus -close for dreamdaemon-gui on Windows).

env.description: Environment variables added to the world process.

debugLibrary.description: Path to a custom debug library for this launch, overriding auxtools.debugLibrary. Falls back to the bundled library when neither is set.

processId.description: Process ID of the running world. Omit to select a running world with the debug library loaded.

dme.description: Path to the project's .dme file if it is not beside the running .dmb.

defines.description: Defines used to build the world: NAME, NAME=VALUE, or DreamMaker -D arguments. If omitted, the extension uses the flags selected in SS13 Build Flags when installed. Set to [] to disable this.

hotReload.description: Reload supported source changes on save. Disabled by default when attaching so reloads do not conflict with the launching session.

sleepingThreads.description: Maximum number of sleeping procs to show in the Call Stack view while paused.
